## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you would like to see.

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve for your listening or focus workflow?

## 🎛️ Proposed Design or Behavior
How should this feature look or behave? (e.g., visualizer mode, keyboard shortcut, tactile UI interaction)

## 🎨 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or references here.
